title: Pass a checkpoint and merge it into the feature branch
statement: As a developer invoking a Plan I decide who passes its checkpoints, myself or the agent unless something is surprising or urgent; once one passes the agent merges it into the branch the Plan's work comes from, and whether it also gets a pull request with colleagues is up to me

acceptance_criteria.statement: Whoever invokes the Plan chooses whether they pass checkpoints themselves or let the agent pass them
An agent allowed to pass a checkpoint stops for a person when the checkpoint's work is surprising or urgent
A pass records who passed the checkpoint and why
Once a checkpoint passes, the agent merges its branch into the branch the Plan's work comes from, and the next checkpoint starts from that branch in a new workspace
Whoever invokes the Plan decides whether a checkpoint also gets a pull request with colleagues
